messages.subject: R 2.14
parts:
Paul

I installed R v 2.14 to get the latest RCy version to run. Now all my
libraries are gone (plyr, Hmisc, custer, adgenet, org.Hs.eg.db,
etc.). I don't recall this happening when I upgraded to earlier
versions of R. Do you know why this happened? or an easy fix? I can
reinstall them of course, but it's a little bit of a pain that I'd
like to avoid in future upgrades.

Thanks,

Mark
